**Subject:** Heater repair needed – [unit/address]

Hi [landlord name],

I'm writing to let you know that the heater in my unit, [unit/address], has been [not working at all / not producing heat / making noise] since [date]. [e.g. I've checked the thermostat and breaker, but it hasn't helped / I haven't tried anything yet.]

With heating season underway, this is affecting the livability of the home, so I'd appreciate getting it fixed soon. Could you arrange a repair or send a technician within the next few days? Please let me know by [reply-by date] when you expect someone to come.

I'm available for access on [days/times], and I'm happy to work around the technician's schedule as well.

Thank you for your help. I appreciate your quick attention to this.

Best regards,
[my name]
[unit/address]

Blanks to fill in: [landlord name], [my name], [unit/address], the heater problem, [date], what you've tried, [reply-by date], and [days/times] for access.
